title: The decision log shows who sorted each conversation and no text (fake data)
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, open Settings › General › Auto labels and click Classify recent mail
Switch Show between All, Rules and Model, then click Clear decision log… and confirm
expected: Rows show the conversation's subject (read from this Mac's mail), the label and who decided (rule: <name>, model, or model said X), and whether it is in Gmail or on this Mac. “Keep subject and preview text” is off. Clearing empties the log and changes no mail.
